code:
MERGE INTO gold.DimStore AS target
USING StoreUpdates AS source
ON target.store_id = source.store_id
   AND target.is_current = 1
WHEN MATCHED AND target.region <> source.region THEN
  UPDATE SET target.end_date = current_date(),
             target.is_current = 0
caption: A store's region history, tracked as a targeted merge.
